PF1SPHERES.NeedGM: A GM must be logged in for this.
PF1SPHERES.TraditionEmpty: No members yet: pick them from the list, or drag them here from the sheet.
PF1SPHERES.TraditionNoCandidates: Every feature is already in a tradition.
PF1SPHERES.TraditionRemove: Remove from this tradition (the item stays on the sheet)
PF1SPHERES.TraditionHint: A tradition. Its talents, drawbacks and boons are added on the Spheres tab and appear with it there instead of in Features. Deleting the tradition leaves them on the sheet.

Leadership.Title: Leadership
Leadership.MythicFollowers: Leadership (Mythic) at tier 5+: your ten highest-level followers are 1st-tier mythic.

Mod.companion: Cohort: has an animal companion, familiar or special mount
Mod.stronghold: Followers: has a stronghold, base or guildhouse

PF1SPHERES.SpellPoolItemHint: Your spell pool, kept by the Spheres module: its maximum follows your casting classes and casting ability modifier. Abilities with a spell point cost draw their charges from it.
PF1SPHERES.BatteredHint:
-2 to CMD
Cannot take AoOs provoked by combat maneuvers

Checks.ConcentrationContinuousHalf: Continuous damage counts only for half

Auto.SpCostHint: A formula. Using the action spends it from the spell pool, and is refused if the pool is short.
Auto.TrackHint: Lists it under Active effects on the Spheres tab with its duration, and ends what it applied when it ends.
Auto.ConcentrationField: Starts as concentration; the Spheres tab offers to spend 1 spell point to make it last the duration above.
Auto.BuffHint: A copy goes on each target (or on you if there are none), with its level set to your caster level in the chosen sphere.
Auto.BuffNeedsActor: Open this from an item on a character to pick one of their buffs.
Auto.ZoneHint: An area centred on you, drawn on the scene, that gives the buff above to creatures inside it (totems, wards).
Auto.MarkAttacker: Note on your attacks against them
Auto.MarkDefender: Note on their attacks against you
Auto.MarkHint: [[formula]] in a note is filled with your numbers when the mark is placed.
Auto.SquadronMark: Applies to your squadron's attacks too
Auto.AlliesNone: Target the allies, then press Set from targets.
Auto.PhalanxHint: Next to other members of the squadron: +2 circumstance to AC and melee attacks, +1 per extra adjacent member. Kept up to date as tokens move.
Auto.NeedHD: This needs {need} Hit Dice; you have {have}.
Auto.InoculatedDamage: {name} is inoculated: no damage from this alchemical item.
Auto.InoculateTooMany: You can inoculate up to {max} allies (your Intelligence bonus).
Auto.InoculateNone: Target your allies, then press Inoculate.
Auto.ZoneAtTemplate: Where you place the action's template
Auto.ZoneAtHint: For a template, give the action a measured template (Usage tab); the area replaces it once placed.
Auto.SequenceTooShort: This finisher needs a sequence of {need} links; it has {have}.
Auto.SequenceOpener: Opener (starts a sequence, or adds a link)
Auto.SequenceLink: Link (adds a link to a running sequence)
Auto.SequenceFinisher: Finisher (needs a length, then ends the sequence)
Auto.ThreatNext: Next attack this turn threatens a critical
Auto.SpentSPForFocus: Spent {cost} spell point(s) in place of martial focus.
Auto.OnFailHint: When a creature fails the save rolled from this action's chat card, the GM's client applies these to it.
Auto.FailConditionsHint: pf1 condition ids, e.g. blind, deaf, dazzled, staggered.
Auto.FailNoteHint: Posted with the result; [[formula]] is rolled once, with your roll data.
Auto.RegainFocusPrompt: You may regain martial focus as an immediate action.
Auto.NotEnoughSP: This costs {cost} spell points; you have {value}.
Auto.ConcentrationHint: Concentrate (a standard action) to keep these going, or they end.
Auto.ConcentrationEasy: Concentrate (a move action, Easy Focus) to keep these going, or they end.
Auto.SequenceLost: No link was added since your last turn: the sequence drops to {length}.
Auto.PersistHint: Spend 1 spell point so it lasts its full duration without concentration
Auto.BuildBlastsHint: Rebuilds destructive blast actions on your Destruction Sphere item from your blast type and shape talents
Auto.MsbVsHint: Roll d20 + MSB against each targeted creature's MSD
Auto.NoDestruction: No Destruction Sphere item on this character.
Auto.FullDice: +1 spell point: one die per caster level
Auto.BlastNote: Melee touch or ranged touch (ray) within close range. Subject to spell resistance.
Auto.BlastsBuilt: Built {count} blast actions ({dice} dice at your caster level).
Auto.NoTargetsMsd: No targets: compare against the MSD you're contesting.
Auto.MsdEstimate: * Not a spherecaster: MSD estimated as 11 + caster level or Hit Dice.
Auto.PerCreature: Each creature can benefit {uses} times per day.
Auto.ElixirNote: Removes 1d{die} ability damage from one ability score.
Auto.NeutralizerNote: Energy resistance {er} against {energy} for {minutes} minutes or {attacks} attacks.
Auto.ElixirUpgrade: Each +5 DC: one more ability score, 2 points of drain removed, or a bigger die.
Auto.PanaceaUpgrade: DC 20: minor conditions; DC 30 adds disease, poison and worse; DC 40 adds fear, blindness, paralysis and stun.
Auto.AmbrosiaUpgrade: DC 25 a curse; 35 negative levels; 40 lost limbs and senses; 50 all negative levels and more.
Auto.NeutralizerUpgrade: Each +10 DC: one more attack absorbed and 10 more minutes.
Auto.FormulaeHint: Each batch takes 30 minutes (15 with an alchemist's lab or crafting kit). Formulae expire after 24 hours and are removed then.
Auto.OverCapacity: That's more than you can hold prepared at once.
Auto.TooManyFormulae: You can hold {max} prepared; {prepared} already are.
Auto.PreparedChat: Prepared {count} formulae in {batches} batches ({minutes} minutes, {lab} with a lab):

Weather.Title: Weather
Weather.Apply: Apply to tokens on this scene
Weather.ApplyHint: Gives every creature token on the scene a managed Weather buff with these modifiers and reminders, and keeps it updated. Sheltered tokens are left out.
Weather.NoneSheltered: None. Select tokens on the canvas and shelter them to leave them out (indoors, in a tent).
Weather.LightningHint: Rolls the bolt's damage once and each targeted creature's Reflex save (half on a success). A Weather-sphere caster's storm uses their sphere DC.
Weather.BuffManaged: Managed by the Weather panel; changes made here are overwritten.
Weather.SelectTokens: Select one or more tokens on this scene first.
Weather.TargetTokens: Target one or more tokens first.
Weather.NoStorm: There is no storm: precipitation and wind must both be severity 4 or higher.
Weather.GMOnly: Only a GM can open the Weather panel.
Weather.ControllerHint: A Weather-sphere caster set this weather. Releasing it restores the weather from before they took control.
Weather.ShipSmasher: Ship Smasher: full damage to objects and vehicles.
Weather.ShipKiller: Ship Killer: double damage to objects and vehicles.
Weather.PerRound: Storm Lord (twice): one strike per round, aimed by the caster.
Weather.Chosen: Storm Lord: the caster chooses where bolts land.
Weather.NeedGM: A GM must be logged in to change scene weather.
Weather.SnowDepth: {depth} in. of snow on the ground.
Weather.SnowDepthMove: {depth} in. of snow: entering a square costs {extra} extra square(s) of movement.
Weather.SnowNotFalling: Not snowing, so the depth holds (snow doesn't melt on its own; set it by hand).

SnowFalling.light: Light snow is falling: 1 in. every 2 hours of game time (Ultimate Wilderness).
SnowFalling.medium: Snow is falling: 1 in. per hour of game time (Ultimate Wilderness).
SnowFalling.heavy: Heavy snow is falling: 1d4 in. per hour of game time (Ultimate Wilderness).

Weather.ChartLabel: Weather chart: temperature across, humidity up. Arrow keys move the point.
Weather.ChartHint: Click or drag a point: temperature across, humidity up. 0 is normal weather and each step out is one severity, up to 7 at ±6. Shaded areas show the conditions at this wind strength.
Weather.ChartReadonly: The scene's weather now. Only the GM changes it here; a Control Weather caster uses their own panel.
Weather.NotACaster: This character doesn't have the Weather sphere.
Weather.OptPersist: Spend 1 spell point so it lasts without concentration
Weather.OptGreater: Greater Weather: extra categories (+1 spell point each)
Weather.OptClimate: Climate: 2-mile radius after 20 minutes (+1 spell point)
Weather.NotEnoughSP: This costs {cost} spell points; you have {value}.
Weather.NothingChanged: Move a slider to change the weather first.
Weather.PaidMythic: Paid with a Mythic Talent use.
Weather.MantleHint: Target creatures on this scene to bestow your mantle (touch, standard action). They treat the weather as less severe.
Weather.TooManyTargets: Your mantle can reach at most {max} creatures.
Weather.MantleChat: Clear Skies mantle (weather {steps} steps less severe) on {targets}. Spent {cost} spell points.
Weather.AtmosphericNote: Atmospheric Imbuement: air, electric and sonic blasts ignore spell resistance in this storm.
Weather.MantleLine: Clear Skies mantle from {name}: weather counts as {steps} steps less severe.

Settings.Title: Spheres Settings
Settings.AbilitySettingNote: Configure the ability whose modifier will be added e.g. to DCs. In formulas, use {rollPath} to reference this ability modifier.
Settings.ShowSpheresTabNote: Adds the Spheres tab to this character's sheet. It is hidden by default so characters without Spheres content keep an uncluttered sheet.
